stableFactsAndClaims: A replacement handle requires confirmation of mug version through a photograph of the base model code.
The photograph need not show receipts or payment information.
If the code is worn away, give approximate height and sliding-tab versus push-button lid details.
Hand tightening is required because a wrench can damage the threaded insert.
A replacement handle cannot fix a cracked insert; visible cracks require a close photograph for assessment before a part is sent.
